entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure 8C. The gel lanes are the three high-dose animals (3.05E+14 vg) and one vehicle animal only; the low and mid dose groups are not on the panel. The assay is a qualitative end-point RT-PCR, with spike-in lanes beside each tissue and no band in any DRG or spinal cord lane; its sensitivity is not stated. The legend's 'NHPs dosed with INS1201' therefore means the highest dose.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 8C, lanes labelled 3 (vehicle), 10, 11, 12 (each INS1201 3.05E+14 vg) for lumbar spinal cord, sacral spinal cord, cervical, lumbar, thoracic and sacral DRG, cervical and thoracic spinal cord, injection site: no amplicon in any lane; spike-in lane present beside each tissue (faint beside cervical and lumbar DRG).

entries.proposition: PANEL READING, Figure S7B. In the 3-month NHP study DRG vector genomes sit at roughly 0.5 to 4 vg per diploid genome at every level and dose (hand reading of a log-scale bar chart, n = 3 per bar, large per-animal spread), with no steep dose dependence between 5.28E+13 and 3.05E+14 vg; spinal cord is of the same order. No histopathology is on this figure.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure S7B, vector genome biodistribution of spinal cord and DRG, 3 months: cervical, thoracic, lumbar and sacral DRG bars for vehicle and three doses all fall between about 0.5 and 4 vg per diploid genome; vehicle bars at or below about 0.1 except scattered points.
